SLA-backed support

Guaranteed response times in writing, a shared channel with our engineers, and escalation paths that don't route through a public issue tracker.

Named engineering contact

A dedicated point of contact who knows your codebase and your rollout — not a fresh ticket every time you reach out.

Security & compliance

Security-review support, SBOMs on request, and answers to your vendor questionnaires so procurement isn't the thing that blocks the ship date.

Custom licensing

Unlimited developer seats, redistribution and OEM terms, and perpetual options — licensing shaped to how your product actually ships.

Flexible deployment

Install from your private registry, run fully on-prem, or operate air-gapped. No phone-home, no runtime license check calling out.

Onboarding & migration

Guided migration from your current grid, an architecture review of your integration, and hands-on help getting the first million rows on screen.

Every Enterprise feature, included.

Row grouping and aggregation, set filters, range and fill handles, rich cell editors, master row dragging, cell notes, and more — all bundled, all supported.
